name: Stellate
author: E. T. Carter
description: A stella octangula — two tetrahedra driven through each other into an eight-pointed star — turning slowly with its spike tips glowing hot, the whole compound breathing its points in and out.

params.label: Spike
params.effect: Length and sharpness of the eight points; low is a stout star, high draws long thin spikes.

params.label: Pulse
params.effect: How much the star breathes — the spikes growing and shrinking in a slow cycle.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Heat of the glowing spike tips and edge rim.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera around the star; 0 ignores the mouse.
